records.answer: The TatarTTS dataset contains around 70 hours of speech [1], recorded by two professional speakers, one male and one female [1]. The duration for the male speaker is 36.2 hours and for the female speaker is 33.9 hours [4].

The apertium-anaphora module increased the accuracy of anaphor translation for Spanish–English by 25 percentage points (from 29.2% to 54.2%) [1]. For Catalan–Italian, it resulted in a slight decrease in accuracy, from 83.3% to 75.0% [1].

The apertium-recursive module was developed to deal with the limitations of finite-state chunking and to apply structural transfer rules recursively using context-free grammars (CFGs) and a Generalized Left-right Right-reduce (GLR) parser [2]. It works by processing nested structures such as relative clauses or prepositional phrases, reversing the word order of nested prepositional phrases to translate from English to Basque [2].

The three golden rules of fat loss in Gutless are calories, protein, and consistency [1]. Rule one concerns the amount of energy measured in calories you get from your diet [4]. Rule two concerns the amount of protein you consume [4]. Rule three concerns the consistency with which you follow the first two rules [4].

records.answer: Gutless says the timing of a water preload should depend on your age because younger individuals (20s and 30s) have a faster gastric emptying rate, so a 30-minute preload is unlikely to influence calorie intake [2]. Older individuals (40s and beyond) have a slower gastric emptying rate, so a water preload consumed between 30 minutes and immediately before a meal is more effective [2].

records.answer: The baseline TatarTTS models were built using the TatarTTS corpus, which consists of 70 hours of transcribed speech from two speakers [1]. Preliminary TTS models were created as a baseline for the Tatar language [1]. The models were trained on the dataset, with each model trained on A100 GPUs on an NVIDIA DGX server [4]. The training approach involved the random initialization of VITS models for both female and male speakers, followed by training on the dataset for 1,000 epochs per speaker [2].
